messages:
Priya: Pushed AWQ calibration pass for mpt-7b-v2 to staging. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/models/mpt-7b-v2/awq/calib-2026-03-16

Priya: Config used:
```
model: mpt-7b-v2
quant: awq
precision: int4
calib_dataset: squad-mini-v2 (2k examples)
kv_caching: enabled
clip_norm: 1.0
```

Marco: Quick heads-up — tokenizer edgecases during calib: the new tokenizer splits the “—” em dash into multiple tokens and treats U+200B zero-width space as separate token. That inflates avg seq len by ~2 tokens on newswire subset.

Liam: Do we have a diff of tokenizer vocab vs prod? If new vocab id mapping changed we'll need remap in serving.

Priya: vocab diff at s3://redwood-staging/models/mpt-7b-v2/tokenizer/vocab-diff-20260316.json
Also ran a small eval: exact-match drop on squad from 79.1 -> 78.6 after AWQ int4 (delta -0.5). Latency improved ~19% median. See QA-Bot summary below.

QA-Bot: smoke results (staging cluster us-west-2-dedicated):
- EM: 78.6
- F1: 86.2
- P50 latency: 110ms -> 89ms
- Memory footprint: -26%
- Perf regressions: none over 5k requests

Marco: FP8 path: someone tried fp8-quant on same weights? any accuracy delta?

Tara: I ran a quick FP8 sweep on a single node: EM 78.2 (delta -0.9), but memory and perf improvements smaller than AWQ; also had rare nan issues in fused-kernel on CUDA 12.3 :cry:

Priya: For rollout plan I propose:
1) Keep AWQ int4 in staging with prefix caching enabled
2) Run 100k tokens of regression eval across our perf/quality suites
3) If EM delta <= -0.7 and error rate <0.05% promote to canary

Liam: LGTM on plan, but ops needs explicit weights ACL and path mapping for private customers.

ops-oncall: Permissions set for staging path to redwood-eng/eng-ml (read only). If you want dedicated mapping to /models/serve we can symlink during deploy.

Marco: One more tokenizer quirk: the tokenizer added a special token "<|user|>" and it shifts indexes >30000 for some models. Can we clamp tokenizer to 30k vocab for serving or remap? This breaks some quant kernels that assume fixed vocab size.

Priya: Noted. I'll open a tiny PR to remap incoming token ids during preprocess. Ping @Marco for review.

Marco: I'll review, ping me when ready. Also can we add a smoke script to CI that tokenizes a representative sample to catch this earlier?

Priya: good call — adding smoke-tokenizer job to eng-ml CI. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Liam: approving AWQ calibration to continue in staging :thumbsup:

Marco: :thumbsup:

Tara: Flagging FP8 flaky kernel in GH issue #4821, linking here.

Priya: Thanks all — will follow up with PR links and the 100k tokens eval artifact once complete.

QA-Bot: note: next QA sweep scheduled in ~6 hours, will post final numbers as thread updates.
